_comment: THE tsconfig lock table, for all seven repositories. One table, here.
Without this list, `extends` is only a suggestion: every repository will switch off
whichever strictness annoys it, and we end up with seven diverging configurations
under a common name. Seven copies of this table would be fault E2 applied to
tooling — hence one file, and a gate that reads it.
What the gate catches and nothing else does: the "strict": false added one evening
to get a migration through, and never removed.

strict.why: A repository that is "almost strict" has none of strict's guarantees.

noUncheckedIndexedAccess.why: array[i] is T | undefined — the number one source of production errors.

exactOptionalPropertyTypes.why: { a?: string } does not accept { a: undefined }.

noImplicitOverride.why: A method that believes it overrides and does not is silent.

noFallthroughCasesInSwitch.why: Exhaustiveness over literal unions (section 5.3) depends on it.

noImplicitReturns.why: A path with no return yields undefined without saying so.

useUnknownInCatchVariables.why: This is where `any` most often comes back into a strict project.

isolatedModules.why: Metro, SWC and esbuild transpile file by file.

verbatimModuleSyntax.why: Forces `import type` and removes elision ambiguity.

forceConsistentCasingInFileNames.why: One case-sensitivity mismatch between macOS and Linux is enough to lose an evening.

forbidden.baseUrl: Carries a path (so it resolves from node_modules/@arthome/tooling/) AND is a hard error under TypeScript 7. Write `paths` without baseUrl, in the repository.
forbidden.outFile: Hard error under TypeScript 7. Use a bundler.
forbidden.ignoreDeprecations: Silences nothing under TypeScript 7: using it would only postpone the work.

target.why: Hard error under TypeScript 7: ES2015 is the minimum.

moduleResolution.why: Hard error under TypeScript 7. Use nodenext or bundler.

esModuleInterop.why: Hard error under TypeScript 7: always on.

allowSyntheticDefaultImports.why: Hard error under TypeScript 7: always on.

alwaysStrict.why: Hard error under TypeScript 7: all code is strict mode.

scoped._why: Locks that apply only to certain files. Checked when the target file is one of them.

redefinable._why: This MUST be possible: a base that is too rigid gets bypassed instead of extended.

mustNotCarryPaths._why: Relative paths in an extended tsconfig resolve FROM THE FILE THEY ARE WRITTEN IN. An include: ["src"] in the base would literally compile @arthome/tooling's own sources.
